generations.text: Elias Mbeki contacted support because the Strata Mini jams the rear tray since 2026-03-11. It is a High priority case and the status is currently Escalated. A replacement unit was shipped under RMA-27017 on 2026-03-18. The agent offered a replacement of $240.00. The customer confirmed order ORD-38159 and asked for a cancellation. The knowledge base notes that Nimbus Hub reboots during updates when the 5-minute window is interrupted.
